elements.manual_reason: No candidate box covers the Version 1 dropdown panel as a whole; only its individual list rows have OCR boxes.
elements.label: Version 1 dropdown panel

pattern.description: The cursor clicks the Version 1 selector; a dropdown with a search field, tabs and a list of plan versions (Budget Pass 1 highlighted, May Forecast visible) opens, while the report view enlarges so the dropdown fills more of the frame.
pattern.why_premium: The scale-up and dropdown open land together right after 'the new May forecast we just created', so the viewer's eye goes straight to the version list instead of hunting a small UI control.

build_hint.gsap: tl.to('.report', {scale:1.13, transformOrigin:'15% 20%', duration:0.35, ease:'power2.out'}); tl.fromTo('.dropdown', {opacity:0, clipPath:'inset(0 0 100% 0)'}, {opacity:1, clipPath:'inset(0 0 0% 0)', duration:0.2, ease:'power2.out'}, '<'); tl.fromTo('.dropdown li', {opacity:0}, {opacity:1, duration:0.1, stagger:0.02}, '<0.05').
build_hint.remotion: const s = spring({frame, fps, config:{damping:30, stiffness:170, mass:1}}); scale = interpolate(s, [0,1], [1, 1.13]); dropdown clip reveal via interpolate(frame, [0, 5], [100, 0]) on inset bottom, with clamp.

notes: camera.move is 'none' although raw scale is 1.13; the enlargement is reported as the report panel (b01) scaling, not a camera push-in. Whether it is a screen-recording zoom or a UI scale is ambiguous. Item b07 OCR 'Strategic Pla' read as 'Strategic Plan Pass 1' from the frame (cursor overlaps). Energy decays steadily, consistent with an ease-out.
